blends.name: HOOTRIX Blend
blends.desc:
Welcome to the HOOTRIX & the HOOTRIX blends!

Take your common [HOOTRIX NFT](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/nerdsuniteus/drops/145020) & blend with a [HOOTRIX Logo NFT](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/nerdsuniteus/drops/145018) for your chance at one of 4 variants!

Check out the requirements for the BLEND and then submit your NFTs (from the My NFTs section below that) by clicking on the ones you want to blend. The NFTs submitted will be burned, but you'll receive a new HOOTRIX NFT in return.

blends.name: Red, White & HOOT Blend - Wonder Stars
blends.desc:
The 'Red, White & HOOT' blends are here.

Take your common HOOT NFT & blend with a 'Red, White & HOOT' logo for your chance at one of two variants! 

For those who bought ['Red, White & HOOT' packs](https://neftyblocks.com/c/nerdsuniteus/marketplace?sort=created&order=desc&collection_name=nerdsuniteus&match=red%2C%20white%20%26%20Hoot%20pack) on the 4th of July, there are plenty of blend chances to chase after the GRAIL, but if you missed out, there are still commons and logos available on the market.

Check out the requirements for the BLEND and then submit your NFTs (from the My NFTs section below that) by clicking on the ones you want to blend. The NFTs submitted will be burned, but you'll receive a new HOOT NFT in return.

**RARITY**

* Legendary 'Wonder Stars' - 90%
* Grail 'Wonder Stars (GOLD)' - 10%
